sources_method: RPP: BEA MARPP_MSA_2008_2024.csv re-downloaded 2026-10-01 from https://apps.bea.gov/regional/zip/MARPP.zip (file last updated Feb 19 2026); no newer release - 2025 MSA RPPs not yet published, so 2024 all-items values (US=100) are kept and were re-verified against the file. FMR: HUD FY2027 FMRs could not be checked - huduser.gov returned HTTP 202 with an empty body (bot challenge) on 2026-10-01; per zero-retry rule, FY2026 2BR values are carried forward with their original vintage and are NOT re-verified (FY2026 values may be superseded by FY2027, effective Oct 1 2026). Unemployment: BLS LAUS metro rate, not seasonally adjusted, via BLS public API v2 (https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/) on 2026-10-01; latest month August 2026 (preliminary). VAMC: every va.gov facility URL re-checked 2026-10-01 (HTTP 200, no redirect); names kept.

rpp.note: Re-verified 2026-10-01 against current BEA MARPP file; no newer release (2025 MSA RPPs not yet published).

fmr2br.note: carried forward, not re-verified 2026-10-01 (huduser.gov blocked automated fetch; FY2027 FMRs not checked).

unemployment.note: BLS LAUS via public API v2, retrieved 2026-10-01, not seasonally adjusted; August 2026 is preliminary. Prior months: July 4.7, June 4.8, May 4.1. Last quarter: 4.1 (May 2026).
